verdict.rationale: Zero's MCP server documents first-party bulk operations ('Bulk delete emails', 'Bulk archive emails'), which an AI agent can call to act on many emails at once. However, the evidence is a prose-only capability list with no endpoint schema and session-cookie authentication, and bulk support is shown only for delete and archive. Missing for 10: bulk variants of other actions (labeling, mark read/unread, moving), a documented API schema or limits for bulk calls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Bulk delete emails - Bulk archive emails
the only API-adjacent surface is the repository's MCP.md, a prose capability list
